assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game sprite atlas of six independently rotating turret HEADS for a friendly hand-painted dungeon tower-defense game. Make a 1536 by 1024 transparent PNG with EXACTLY THREE columns and TWO rows, six equal square cells 512 by 512. Every head points straight UP on the canvas, in the same top-down three-quarter view. Each head is centered in its cell with 20 percent transparent margin. These are ONLY upper rotating weapons, no pedestals, no ground, no characters, no text, no grid lines, no checkerboard, no shadows outside the weapon. Pivot visually near lower center of each head. Bold dark outline, chunky iron and carved timber, stone trim, amber rivets, friendly colorful fantasy, clear silhouette at 64 pixels. Read cells left to right, top row then bottom row. Preserve real transparent alpha outside all solid head artwork. Subjects: cell 1 compact simple single iron cannon, bronze rim, warm amber; cell 2 twin-barrel iron cannon with two parallel equal barrels and copper braces; cell 3 narrow needle launcher, slim silver barrel and teal accuracy crystal; cell 4 rounded pebble launcher, short wide stone barrel, sandstone and green leaves; cell 5 frost crystal launcher with one radiant cyan ice spear; cell 6 ice-lance weapon with three blue pointed crystals and silver blade supports. All six are visibly distinct upper weapon modules, same scale and view.
